newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Asia Motors to set up plant in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Asia Motors to set up plant in Brazil.

text.p: Asia Motors, a commercial vehicle unit of South Korea's Kia Group, said on Wednesday it had agreed to set up a joint venture plant in Brazil.
Asia said it would hold 51 percent and its sales company in Brazil, Asia Motors do Brasil, 49 percent of the venture. Total capitalisation was set at $20 million.
The plant, to be completed near Salvador, Bahia, by October 1999, will be equipped to produce 60,000 commercial vehicles annually, the company said.
Capacity will rise to 100,000 after the year 2000.
Asia Motors' vehicle exports to Brazil would reach 50,000 units this year, compared with 14,358 units last year.
